issue.title: Upload takes to the project unit they were recorded in [Offline chapter assignment Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the offline chapter assignment audit (#533, epic #526).

**Severity:** High  
**Launch blocker:** To be decided with product  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `main` @ `fb634e5`, `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenario I.3)

## Summary

Recordings are keyed by `bible_text_id` only. When uploading, `getPendingRecordings` resolves the `project_unit_id` by bible + book + chapter with `ORDER BY ca.id LIMIT 1` (`src/db/repository.ts:993-1000`). When two projects (or, with Milestones #333, two units of one project) share the target bible and book, the take is uploaded against the first matching unit, not the one it was recorded in:

- if the translator is not assigned there, the upload gets 404 and the take is stuck (seen on Ruth 3: recorded in unit 473 / assignment 42074, uploaded against 42042);
- if the translator is assigned in both, the audio may be uploaded silently to the wrong project.

A retest on a project with a unique book (Numbers 3) uploaded correctly. PR #552 and a comment on #333 describe the display side of the same root (recordings keyed by `bible_text_id`) as pre-existing; no issue covers the upload.

## Expected

A take is uploaded to the project unit and chapter assignment it was recorded in.

## Actual

The upload targets the lowest matching assignment id for the same bible + book + chapter.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Two projects with the same target bible and the same book (e.g. Ruth), the translator assigned in the second one only.
2. Record a take on Ruth 3 in the second project and upload (Sync Now).
3. The upload fails with 404, or lands in the first project if the translator is assigned there too.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Recordings store (or can resolve unambiguously) the project unit / chapter assignment they were recorded in.
- [ ] Upload uses that unit; takes are shown only in their own project.
- [ ] Migration path for existing local recordings.
- [ ] Unit tests with two projects sharing bible + book; Android device QA.

## Related

- Parent audit: #533 (epic #526)
- #333 (Milestones), PR #552, #528 (record audit), #530 (upload)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/offline-chapter-assignment/README.md` (PR #609)
